_comment: Local model per hardware tier, best first. loadout model --recommend picks the first tier the machine meets. vramGiB is usable GPU memory (on Apple Silicon, about 65% of unified memory). Only entries with 'measured' were benchmarked; the rest are estimates. Rerun local-llm/bench.sh and update this file when you measure a tier.

tiers.note: Higher-precision quant of the 16 GB pick. For more precision at a third of the speed, the dense Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_M (16.6 GB) also fits.

tiers.measured: RX 6800 16 GB, Vulkan: 775 t/s prompt at 32K, 101 t/s generation, 13.3 GB VRAM at 64K context, tool calls 3/3
tiers.note: Mixture of experts with 3B active parameters: 3.5x faster per agent turn than the dense 27B, slightly less precise.
Some experts stay in system RAM. Tune --n-cpu-moe down until it no longer fits, then back up one.
Good for ask_local drafts and summaries; too weak to run a Copilot agent-mode chat. Keep a frontier model as the chat.
